title: On Hurrying to the gate before dark
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：hurry　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 hurry 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the ranger ① hurried to the gate before dark in silence, and every villager in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the ranger ② hurries to the gate before dark twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ hurry to the gate before dark at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ hurried to the gate before dark before — a line in the survey for October 1958 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Hurrying to the gate before dark in silence, the ranger said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far ridge, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ hurry everybody still behind twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Hurry everybody still behind at once and never mention it again.

By 1971 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the survey, and a new villager from the next valley ⑧ hurries everybody still behind in silence every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the ridge, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ hurried to the gate before dark again when nobody else would.

⑩ To hurry to the gate before dark, my mother said in 1976, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the valley remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the valley forgets, somebody hurries to the gate before dark twice over again and somebody must hurry to the gate before dark in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 赶去（一般过去式 hurried to the gate before dark：1964 年守林人头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 赶去（一般现在 hurries to the gate before dark：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 赶去（不定式 to hurry to the gate before dark：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 赶去（过去完成时 had hurried to the gate before dark：1958 年十月的踏勘记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 赶去（动名词 hurrying to the gate before dark 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 催促（hurry everybody still behind：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去催促催所有还在后面的人）
G. v. 催促（hurry everybody still behind：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 赶去（后段两处：新来的村民照例 hurries everybody still behind，而母亲又一次 hurried to the gate before dark）

answers.why: hurry 意为“赶去”，1964 年守林人一言不发地赶去天黑前急急赶到那道门口，那是山谷里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 hurried。
hurry 意为“赶去”，自那以后守林人来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 hurries。
hurry 意为“赶去”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯赶去天黑前急急赶到那道门口”，此处为不定式 to hurry to the gate before dark。
hurry 意为“赶去”，踏勘记录里 十月 那行字说明早在 1971 年之前就有人赶去过，故用过去完成时 had hurried。
hurry 意为“赶去”，守林人说“赶去天黑前急急赶到那道门口这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 hurrying to the gate before dark 作主语。
hurry 意为“催促”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去催促催所有还在后面的人”，should ever 之后用原形 hurry everybody still behind。
hurry 意为“催促”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻催促催所有还在后面的人（hurry everybody still behind at once），以后再也不要提起。
hurry 意为“赶去”，新来的村民每个季节都照例催促催所有还在后面的人，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 hurries。
hurry 意为“赶去”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地赶去天黑前急急赶到那道门口，用一般过去式 hurried 叙述。
hurry 意为“赶去”，结尾那句是母亲 1976 年的话：要赶去天黑前急急赶到那道门口，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和山谷记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1964 年，守林人一言不发地赶去天黑前急急赶到那道门口；山谷里每一个村民都说这是头一回。（hurried to the gate before dark）
多年以后，守林人仍来回两遍做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（hurries to the gate before dark）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯赶去天黑前急急赶到那道门口这件事本身。（to hurry to the gate before dark）
早在 1958 年就有人赶去天黑前急急赶到那道门口，十月那天踏勘记录上的一行字就是证据。（had hurried to the gate before dark）
守林人说过，一言不发地赶去天黑前急急赶到那道门口这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（hurrying to the gate before dark 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻催促催所有还在后面的人，以后再也不要提起。（hurry everybody still behind，祈使句）
answers: In 1964 the ranger hurried to the gate before dark in silence, and every villager in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three seasons on, the ranger still hurries to the gate before dark twice over without being asked.
My mother said later that to hurry to the gate before dark at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had hurried to the gate before dark long before 1971, and the line in the survey for October proves it.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 hurry 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1964 the ranger hurried to the gate before dark in silence, and nobody in the valley forgot it.
Even now the ranger hurries to the gate before dark twice over whenever the valley asks.
Hurrying to the gate before dark in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever hurry everybody still behind twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new villager from the next valley hurries everybody still behind in silence every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother hurried to the gate before dark again, and the valley remembered that half.
